headline: Netanyahu vows house-to-house clearances, wider West Bank closure prepared
dek: Saturday in Hebron: all gates in and out of the city impassable by car (Basma Radio checkpoint monitor); WAFA: Israeli troops forced dozens of residents to evacuate homes in some neighbourhoods and closed all entrances/roads into the city; AP scene: Reem Al Jiyawi waited at a closed gate to get…
sources: AP via Arab News (Oct 24, 11:21 ); AFP via Khaleej Times/Tribune; IDF + Shin Bet joint statement (late Friday); WAFA; Haaretz
fault_line: Security operation or collective punishment -- and three days before an election, is Hebron about the gunmen or about the vote?

sections.what_happened: Saturday in Hebron: all gates in and out of the city impassable by car (Basma Radio checkpoint monitor); WAFA: Israeli troops forced dozens of residents to evacuate homes in some neighbourhoods and closed all entrances/roads into the city; AP scene: Reem Al Jiyawi waited at a closed gate to get her 11-year-old daughter to a cancer-related appointment in Dura, crossing on foot. IDF/Shin Bet: searches, questioning and demolitions at dozens of locations, operation 'expected to continue for several days'. Netanyahu (Friday visit, via Statesman/AFP): 'We will clear out the residents, go house to house, take out the weapons and all the infrastructure of terror'; directed forces to prepare a wider West Bank closure beyond Hebron. Hamas praised Friday's attack as a 'heroic operation' without claiming it. Context: Israeli election Tuesday Oct 27; Netanyahu in a tight race campaigning on security.
sections.what_verified: AP (T1) on-the-ground Saturday reporting; AFP (T1) via Khaleej Times/Tribune; IDF + Shin Bet joint statement (T1, state IL); WAFA (T3, state PS) for evacuations; Haaretz (T3) for the Friday raid framing. IDF did not respond to AP questions about Saturday's evacuations -- that non-response is recorded, not filled.
sections.what_disputed: Palestinian officials criticise the measures as collective punishment (Statesman); Barghouti (recorded 1100-05): closure turns cities into 'a small prison', 'will lead to explosions'. Netanyahu's scale-back order (full closure -> Hebron+Halhul cordon, recorded 1100-05) vs Saturday's city-wide car closures: the cordon in practice now covers all Hebron gates -- the scale-back and the Saturday closures sit in tension and are both reported, not reconciled.
sections.why_matters: Day two in Hebron: every gate shut to cars, families marched out of their homes -- and the prime minister promises house-to-house clearances three days before Israel votes.
